description: Houston, TX–This Saturday, Congresswoman Lizzie Fletcher (TX-07) filed her paperwork for re-election to the U.S. House of Representatives for Texas’ Seventh Congressional District, with the support and endorsement of leaders throughout the greater Houston area she represents.
